metodos.codigoOriginal:
Lparameters poForm, pOperacao, pComissao

ThisForm.ParentForm = poForm
ThisForm.DataSessionId = poForm.DataSessionId
ThisForm.poDatamgr = poForm.poDataMgr
ThisForm.pComis = pComissao

ThisForm.cntSombra.lblSombra.Caption = ThisForm.Caption
ThisForm.cntSombra.lblTitulo.Caption = ThisForm.Caption

ThisForm.GetOrigem.Width  	  = 150
ThisForm.GetOrigem.MaxLength  = 20
ThisForm.getDestino.Width 	  = 150
ThisForm.getDestino.MaxLength = 20
If ThisForm.pComis
	ThisForm.GetOrigem.Width  	  = 290
	ThisFor... [TRUNCADO]

If Not Empty(This.Value) And Not Lastkey() = 27
	If ThisForm.pComis
		lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
				    [From SigCmCab ] + ;
				   [Where Cods = '] + Padr(This.Value, 40) + [']

		If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalBus]) < 1)
			=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalBus)])
			Return 0
		EndIf
		Go Top In LocalBus
		If Not Eof([LocalBus])
			=MessageBox([Descrição do Cadastro de Comissão Já Informado!!!], 0+16, [Atenção!!!])
			Return .f.
		En... [TRUNCADO]

If Empty(ThisForm.GetDestino.Value)
	MessageBox('Destino Invalido !!!',16,'')
	Return
EndIf

lcOpeOri = ThisForm.GetOrigem.Value
lcOpeDes = ThisForm.GetDestino.Value

If ThisForm.pComis
	lcQuery = [Select * ] + ;
			    [From SigCmCab ] + ;
			   [Where Cods = '] + Padr(Thisform.getOrigem.Value, 40) + [']

	If (ThisForm.poDataMgr.SqlExecute(lcQuery, [LocalCmCab]) < 1)
		=MessageBox([Favor Reinicializar o Processo!!!], 16, [Falha na Conexão (LocalCmCab)])
		Return 0
	EndIf
	Go Top In LocalCmCab
	... [TRUNCADO]
